title_uz: Maqsad taqsimoti va vaqt bo'yicha ulush
title_en: Target balance and rate over time
caption_uz: Signallarning 17.2% qismi eskalatsiya qilingan (2,405 / 14,000). Oylik ulush 13.9%–21.2% oralig'ida tebranadi, lekin statistik ahamiyatli trend yo'q (χ² p = 0.09), shuning uchun kalendar belgilar modelga kiritilmadi.
caption_en: 17.2% of alerts are escalated (2,405 of 14,000). The monthly rate moves between 13.9% and 21.2% but shows no significant pattern (chi-square p = 0.09), so calendar features were left out.
alt: Bar chart of class counts and a line chart of monthly escalation rate with a 95% confidence band.

title_uz: Tarix hajmi: eskalatsiya va rad etilganlar
caption_uz: Eskalatsiya qilingan signallarda tranzaksiyalar biroz ko'proq (median 453 vs 417; Cliff δ = 0.062, p < 0.001) — farq kichik. Deyarli barcha tarixlar signalgacha ~180 kunni qamraydi.
caption_en: Escalated alerts have slightly more transactions (median 453 vs 417; Cliff's delta = 0.062, p < 0.001) — a small effect. Almost every history covers ~180 days before the alert.
alt: Overlaid histograms of transaction count and history length for escalated and dismissed alerts.

title_en: Activity aligned to the alert (event time)
caption_uz: Kunlik faollik (oxirgi 3 daqiqalik portlash bundan mustasno) eskalatsiya qilinganlarda butun oyna bo'ylab ~6% yuqori; egri chiziqlar shakli bir xil. Ya'ni signal oldidan maxsus 'sakrash' yo'q — farq doimiy faollik darajasida.
caption_en: Daily activity (excluding the 3-minute burst) is ~6% higher for escalated alerts across the whole window, with the same shape. There is no special pre-alert spike: the difference is a steady level shift.
alt: Line chart of mean daily transactions per alert over the 180 days before the alert, with 95% bands.

caption_uz: Tranzaksiyalarning 7.9% qismi signal sanasidan oldingi kechaning 23:57–23:59 oralig'iga to'plangan (signallarning 98.9% qismida, median 31 ta). Bu sintetik generator artefakti; alohida belgilar sifatida ishlatildi (OOF AUC +0.007), lekin o'zi zaif (Cliff δ = 0.025).
caption_en: 7.9% of all transactions are stamped 23:57–23:59 on the evening before the alert date (98.9% of alerts, median 31 each). This is a generator artefact; we summarise it as separate features (+0.007 OOF AUC) but it is weak on its own (Cliff's delta = 0.025).
alt: Histogram of burst timestamps in the last 3 minutes and overlaid histograms of burst size by class.

caption_uz: Kirim tranzaksiyalar ~76% ni tashkil etadi. Eskalatsiya qilinganlarda kirim ulushi deyarli bir xil (Cliff δ = -0.025), sof oqim bo'yicha farq ham kichik (δ = -0.020): yo'nalish yolg'iz o'zi kuchli signal emas.
caption_en: About 76% of transactions are incoming. The incoming share is nearly identical across classes (Cliff's delta = -0.025) and net flow differs only slightly (delta = -0.020): direction alone is not a strong signal.
alt: Box plots of incoming share and normalised net flow by class.

caption_uz: Tur tarkibi sinflar orasida deyarli bir xil (tranzaksiya darajasida Cramér V = 0.004). Issiqlik xaritasi eskalatsiya qilinganlardagi ulushning rad etilganlarga nisbatini ko'rsatadi: bank o'tkazmasi chiqimlari bir oz ko'proq, lekin farqlar ±5% atrofida.
caption_en: The type mix is almost identical between classes (transaction-level Cramér's V = 0.004). The heatmap shows the share among escalated divided by the share among dismissed: differences stay within about ±5%.
alt: Grouped bar chart of transaction type shares by class and a heatmap of type-by-direction lift.

caption_uz: Eng aniq naqsh: eskalatsiya qilinganlarda kichik bank o'tkazmalari ko'proq, kattalari esa kamroq (bank o'tkazmasi o'rtacha miqdori median 0.06 vs 0.21; Cliff δ = -0.131, p < 0.001). Bu 'bo'lib-bo'lib o'tkazish' ga o'xshash xulq bo'lishi mumkin, ammo aniq chegara oldida to'planish topilmadi.
caption_en: Clearest pattern: escalated alerts have relatively more small bank transfers and fewer large ones (per-alert mean transfer amount, median 0.06 vs 0.21; Cliff's delta = -0.131, p < 0.001). This resembles splitting payments, but no bunching just below a threshold was found (smurfing test, arXiv 2309.12704).
alt: Line chart of the escalated-to-dismissed density ratio across amount bins for card, transfer and cash.

caption_uz: Miqdor turlar bo'yicha keskin farq qiladi: xalqaro > naqd > bank o'tkazmasi > karta. Shu sababli miqdor belgilari har bir tur ichida alohida (va tur × yo'nalish bo'yicha) hisoblandi.
caption_en: Amount level differs sharply by type: international > cash > transfer > card. Amount features are therefore computed within each type (and type × direction), not only overall.
alt: Grouped box plots of amount quantiles by transaction type and class.

caption_uz: Signal oldidan oxirgi kunlarda faollik tarixiy o'rtachadan past (egri chiziqlar 1 dan past), chunki faollik ~130 kun oldin eng yuqori bo'lgan. Ikkala sinfda shakl bir xil; farqlar juda kichik (eng katta |δ| = 0.021).
caption_en: In the last days before the alert activity is below the history average (curves under 1), because activity peaks ~130 days earlier. The shape is the same for both classes; differences are tiny (largest |delta| = 0.021).
alt: Line chart of median window-to-history activity ratio for 1 to 90 day windows by class.

caption_uz: Tarixiy tranzaksiyalar soatlar bo'yicha deyarli tekis taqsimlangan (sintetik ma'lumot); 23-soatdagi cho'qqi butunlay 3 daqiqalik portlash hisobiga. Hafta kunlari ham ikki sinfda bir xil — tungi/dam olish belgilari ablatsiyada foyda bermadi.
caption_en: Historical transactions are almost uniform over the hours (synthetic data); the 23:00 spike is entirely the 3-minute burst. Weekday shares are also the same for both classes — night/weekend features did not help in ablation.
alt: Stacked bar chart of transactions per hour split into history and burst, and weekday share by class.

caption_uz: Birorta belgi 0.58 AUC dan oshmaydi (eng kuchlisi bank_otkazmasi_chiqim_mean = 0.574); 26 ta belgi 0.55 dan yuqori. Signal ko'p kuchsiz, o'zaro bog'liq belgilarga tarqalgan — shu sabab kuchli regulyarizatsiyali GBDT va ansambl tanlandi. To'q sariq = eskalatsiya bilan musbat.
caption_en: No single feature exceeds 0.58 AUC (strongest: bank_otkazmasi_chiqim_mean = 0.574); 26 features exceed 0.55. The signal is spread over many weak, correlated features — hence heavily regularised GBDTs and an ensemble. Orange = positively associated with escalation.
alt: Horizontal bar chart of univariate AUC for the top 25 features and a Spearman correlation heatmap.

caption_uz: Train va test bir xil taqsimotdan: adversarial validatsiya AUC = 0.502 (0.5 = farqlab bo'lmaydi), top-25 belgilar bo'yicha maksimal KS = 0.022. Sanalar oralig'i ham bir xil (2025-01-01 … 2026-12-31) → tasodifiy bo'linish, stratifikatsiyalangan K-fold CV.
caption_en: Train and test come from the same distribution: adversarial validation AUC = 0.502 (0.5 = indistinguishable), max KS over the top-25 features = 0.022. Date ranges are identical (2025-01-01 … 2026-12-31) → random split, so stratified K-fold CV is appropriate.
alt: Four overlaid histograms comparing train and test distributions of the strongest features.

caption_uz: Har bir belgi oilasi olib tashlanganda OOF AUC qancha tushadi (LightGBM, 5×2 CV). Agregatlar asosiy hissa qo'shadi; oxirgi 20 tranzaksiya va portlash belgilari ham foydali; vaqt naqshlari va pass-through foyda bermadi va yakuniy to'plamdan chiqarildi.
caption_en: How much OOF AUC drops when each feature family is removed (LightGBM, 5×2 CV). Aggregates carry most of the signal; the last-20-transactions and burst families also help; time-pattern and pass-through families did not help and were dropped from the final set.
alt: Horizontal bar chart of AUC lost when each feature family is removed.
